title: Tristana
writer: Julio Alejandro, Luis Buñuel, Benito Pérez Galdós
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Fernando Rey, Franco Nero
plot: Shortly after her mother's death, an innocent and youthful woman will find refuge into the household of her middle-aged aristocratic guardian, who will submit her to his sexual advances.
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 11 wins & 4 nominations total
